identification: AWA Radiolette model 500MY, 1946-47, 4-valve (6A8G, 6G8G, 6V6GT, 6X5GT) broadcast-only superhet mantel radio in brown bakelite, four red-cloth horizontal grille slots, round dial on right with AWA-badge pointer, two knobs. Matched to the radiomuseum.org 500MY picture (same cabinet, dial and slots). Chassis plate reads MODEL 500MY (photo 2 zoomed), serial 000?1993. Old twisted brown cloth flex with Bakelite plug.
